import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int n, t;
    static class Pkt {
        int x, y;
        Pkt(int x, int y) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
        }
    }
    static class Kraw {
        int a, res;
        Kraw(int a, int res) {
            this.a = a;
            this.res = res;
        }
    }

    static int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1, 0};

    static boolean Ok(int x, int y) {
        return (x >= 0 && x < n && y >= 0 && y < n);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();

        String[] nau = new String[n];
        String[] pom = new String[n];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            nau[i] = sc.nextLine();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            pom[i] = sc.nextLine();
        }

        int[][] odl = new int[n][n];
        for (int[] row : odl) Arrays.fill(row, 1000);

        Pkt start = null;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (nau[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    start = new Pkt(i, j);
                }
            }
        }

        Queue<Pkt> Q = new LinkedList<>();
        odl[start.x][start.y] = 0;
        Q.offer(start);
        while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
            Pkt akt = Q.poll();
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = akt.x + dx[i];
                int ny = akt.y + dy[i];
                if (Ok(nx, ny) && nau[nx].charAt(ny) >= '0' && nau[nx].charAt(ny) <= '9' && odl[nx][ny] == 1000) {
                    odl[nx][ny] = odl[akt.x][akt.y] + 1;
                    Q.offer(new Pkt(nx, ny));
                }
            }
        }

        boolean[][][][][] moge = new boolean[60][10][10][10][10];
        for (int i = 0; i < 60; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < 10; j++)
                for (int k = 0; k < 10; k++)
                    for (int l = 0; l < 10; l++)
                        for (int m = 0; m < 10; m++)
                            moge[i][j][k][l][m] = false;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                    int l = i + dx[k], m = j + dy[k];
                    if (Ok(l, m) && nau[i].charAt(j) >= '0' && nau[i].charAt(j) <= '9' && nau[l].charAt(m) >= '0' && nau[l].charAt(m) <= '9') {
                        moge[0][i][j][l][m] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= t - 2; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                    for (int l = 0; l < n; l++) {
                        for (int m = 0; m < n; m++) {
                            if (!moge[i][j][k][l][m]) continue;
                            for (int o = 0; o < 4; o++) {
                                int p = l + dx[o], r = m + dy[o];
                                if (Ok(p, r) && nau[p].charAt(r) >= '0' && nau[p].charAt(r) <= '9' && odl[l][m] >= i + 2 && odl[p][r] >= i + 2) {
                                    moge[i + 1][j][k][p][r] = true;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        List<Pkt> a = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (nau[i].charAt(j) >= '0' && nau[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    a.add(new Pkt(i, j));
                }
            }
        }

        int wie = 2 * a.size() + 2;
        List<List<Kraw>> G = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < wie; i++) {
            G.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < a.size(); i++) {
            G.get(0).add(new Kraw(i + 1, nau[a.get(i).x].charAt(a.get(i).y) - '0'));
            G.get(i + 1).add(new Kraw(0, 0));
            G.get(a.size() + 1 + i).add(new Kraw(wie - 1, pom[a.get(i).x].charAt(a.get(i).y) - '0'));
            G.get(wie - 1).add(new Kraw(a.size() + 1 + i, 0));
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < a.size(); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < a.size(); j++) {
                boolean ok = false;
                for (int k = 0; k <= t - 1; k++) {
                    if (moge[k][a.get(i).x][a.get(i).y][a.get(j).x][a.get(j).y]) {
                        ok = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (ok) {
                    G.get(i + 1).add(new Kraw(a.size() + 1 + j, 1000));
                    G.get(a.size() + 1 + j).add(new Kraw(i + 1, 0));
                }
            }
        }

        int odp = 0;
        while (true) {
            boolean[] odw = new boolean[wie];
            int[] pop = new int[wie];
            Arrays.fill(pop, -1);
            Queue<Integer> Q2 = new LinkedList<>();
            odw[0] = true;
            Q2.offer(0);
            while (!Q2.isEmpty()) {
                int akt = Q2.poll();
                for (Kraw edge : G.get(akt)) {
                    if (!odw[edge.a] && edge.res > 0) {
                        Q2.offer(edge.a);
                        pop[edge.a] = akt;
                        odw[edge.a] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (pop[wie - 1] == -1) break;
            List<Integer> path = new ArrayList<>();
            int akt = wie - 1;
            while (akt != -1) {
                path.add(akt);
                akt = pop[akt];
            }
            Collections.reverse(path);
            int flow = 1000;
            for (int i = 0; i < path.size() - 1; i++) {
                int from = path.get(i);
                int to = path.get(i + 1);
                for (Kraw edge : G.get(from)) {
                    if (edge.a == to) {
                        flow = Math.min(flow, edge.res);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            odp += flow;
            for (int i = 0; i < path.size() - 1; i++) {
                int from = path.get(i);
                int to = path.get(i + 1);
                for (Kraw edge : G.get(from)) {
                    if (edge.a == to) {
                        edge.res -= flow;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                for (Kraw edge : G.get(to)) {
                    if (edge.a == from) {
                        edge.res += flow;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(odp);
        sc.close();
    }
}
